name: Midi-Reverb
author: ESC_CODE
description: A mono reverb and effects unit that runs the programs of three late-80s Alesis ROMs: MidiVerb I, MidiVerb II and MidiFex. You supply your own ROM dumps; none come with it. Feedback, Cutoff, Mix and Program on the four encoders, with an Original engine and an approximate Low CPU one.
credits: Eric Brombaugh's MIDIVerb_RE (with Paul Schreiber's reverse engineering) and thement's midiverb_emulator
